idea-plugin.name: StudyPilot Local Automation Bridge
idea-plugin.description: Narrow, owner-only local bridge for the three registered StudyPilot IDE recovery actions: open a registered file, focus a registered run configuration, and reveal an existing test result view. It exposes a private owner-only Unix Domain Socket for the local automation service only. It never opens a TCP or HTTP listener, never runs or debugs tests, never executes a generic IntelliJ Action, and never accepts a path, configuration name, free text or selector from a caller.
